subject.title: [Feature]: Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/auth surface, or should Token Plan support stay outside the bundled qwen plugin?
rationale: The request fits the model-provider roadmap, but it adds public provider, auth-choice, env-var, endpoint, and catalog contracts that require maintainer product ownership.

options.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
options.body: Review and repair the linked PR until qwen-token-plan is represented in manifest, docs, generated catalogs, and tests, then merge it as an official qwen provider.

options.title: Route To External Plugin
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish Token Plan support as an external provider plugin if maintainers do not want to own another Alibaba provider contract in the qwen plugin.

options.title: Defer For Stronger Vendor Proof
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the PR until maintainers have stronger Alibaba documentation or account-level proof for provider ids, regions, and model catalog.

recommendation.title: Accept Bundled Token Plan Provider
recommendation.body: Review and repair the linked PR until qwen-token-plan is represented in manifest, docs, generated catalogs, and tests, then merge it as an official qwen provider.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned live and is the strongest history-backed owner for the qwen provider/config product boundary.
